verdict.rationale: Kling's homepage describes a built-in Agent that users can brainstorm with and delegate script writing and image, video and storyboard generation to, followed by multi-round post-production editing. Dedicated Skills generate storyboards, posters and e-commerce assets in parallel. The MCP/CLI item concerns external agents driving Kling, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the agent's scope and controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how well delegation works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Brainstorm with your Agent, write scripts, and generate images, videos, and storyboards—then refine and edit your videos through multiple rounds of post-production.
Use dedicated Skills to create storyboards, posters, e-commerce assets, and more—all generated in parallel.
